summary: Frontend-only verification of the new autocomplete suggestions on /cadastro/visitantes and /cadastro/fixos. All 7 request bullets PASS: (1) /cadastro/visitantes no longer renders portaria-doc-search/portaria-doc-input (confirmed null); LiveAccessFeed + PresentVisitors still present in the right-hand monitor panel. (2) Typing >=3 chars in Nome (f-name) on visitors form shows f-name-suggestions dropdown with ONLY visitor results (kind filter applied in SuggestInput); verified by typing 'Ber' and 'Clar'. Clicking a suggestion loads the record (header 'Edição' + form-title populated). Blacklisted visitor 'Clara Barbosa' (Delta Engenharia) is tagged LISTA NEGRA in the dropdown and triggers blacklist-alert after loading. (3) Documento (f-document) and CPF (f-cpf) fields on visitors form show f-document-suggestions / f-cpf-suggestions with real existing visitors. (4) /cadastro/fixos: typing 'Ana' into f-name shows f-name-suggestions with 7 person results (Ana Costa · NX Corp etc.); clicking loads edit mode. Typing partial CPF '934.9' lists Clara Pereira + Ana Carvalho; typing partial RG '123' also opens f-rg-suggestions. All suggestions are restricted to kind=person for fixos and kind=visitor for visitors. (5) When editing an already loaded record (editId set), onPick is null so SuggestInput is replaced by plain Input — typing 'XYZ' after loading Clara Barbosa produced NO f-name-suggestions dropdown. (6) GET /api/events?limit=10 now returns person_type on 10/10 items (previous iteration flagged this as missing on seeded events — now fixed). Regression on save was not executed (no new TEST_ data created) because the form shape is unchanged and the Suggest work does not touch submit; but save/clear buttons remain functional and the previous iteration had already validated save flows.
critical_code_review_comments: FormBits.SuggestInput: debounce is 300ms and `open` resets to true on every onChange — fine, but the dropdown only renders when items.length>0, so the small 'Já cadastrados — clique para abrir' header is skipped on empty results (desired).

FormFields.T: when opts.onPick is provided, the input renders a SuggestInput WITHOUT forwarding the mask/type/data-testid props; only id-based testid 'f-${key}' is applied via SuggestInput's testid prop, and type/number inputs are forced to text — acceptable for name/document/cpf/rg which are strings, but keep in mind if ever using onPick on a numeric/date field (currently not the case).

PersonForm passes onPick={editId ? null : (r) => run({ kind: r.kind, id: r.id })} — correct: suggestions auto-disable in edit mode. Also still works for the visitor onDocBlur lookup path when the user types a full doc without clicking a suggestion.
seed_data_creation: None. No TEST_ records created — all tests were read-only (navigation + search + suggestion selection + Limpar).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autocomplete lives in frontend/src/components/registry/FormBits.jsx SuggestInput; it hits GET /api/registry/search?q=... and filters client-side by kind ('visitor' for /cadastro/visitantes, 'person' for /cadastro/fixos). Testids: f-name, f-document, f-cpf, f-rg + corresponding -suggestions and suggest-option-{id}. Minimum 3 chars triggers search (300ms debounce). In edit mode (editId set), SuggestInput is swapped for a plain Input so no dropdown is shown. Blacklisted visitors (visitor.blacklist=true) are tagged LISTA NEGRA inside the dropdown via status==='lista negra'. The big doc-search block previously at the top of /cadastro/visitantes has been removed completely from Registry.jsx VisitorRegister.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported issues are resolved. The iteration_4 minor finding (seeded /api/events missing person_type) is now fixed: GET /api/events returned person_type on 10/10 sampled items.
